description: Phase 4 MerLin adaptation of the Section 4.3 SRG experiment: the paper's protocol (all 25 catalog graphs, five isomorphic controls per graph, sorted half-L1 distance, tolerance 1e-9) applied to photonic walk covariances through the interferometer U(t) = exp(-i 2 A t). The paper's interacting two-particle walk is recomputed in the same run as the reference. Main rows: 2 and 3 photons with threshold detection postselected on n clicks. Ablations: 1 photon, 2 photons with number-resolving detection (no postselection), 2 distinguishable photons with postselection (closed form; MerLin simulates indistinguishable photons only).
